title: 有馬記念の後に・ずっと、ずーっと

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Huff… huff… huff…

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Trainer… I… I…

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Yeah! Thanks!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: I got first place! I really won!

text_block_list.name: Loud Cheers
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Whoa! They're so loud!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Haru Urara did it! She finally did it! Sob…

text_block_list.name: Energetic Shopkeeper
text_block_list.text: Urara! Sob… Congratulatiooons!

text_block_list.name: Kind Shopkeeper
text_block_list.text: Hic… Hic… You were amazing, Urara!

text_block_list.name: Happy Shopkeeper
text_block_list.text: Sob… Sob… I'm so happy!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Is everyone… crying? Oh no! Why?!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: They're so happy they're crying? No! That's not right!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: You gotta smile, everyone! I want you to be happy!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: I wanted to make people smile. So, please smile for me!

text_block_list.name: Kind Shopkeeper
text_block_list.text: Urara…

text_block_list.name: Energetic Shopkeeper
text_block_list.text: Heh, she's right. This is Urara's happy day. We gotta smile for her!

text_block_list.name: Happy Shopkeeper
text_block_list.text: Sniff… Urara… Congratulations! Congraaatulations!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Yeah, that's more like it! Thank you!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Urara, congratulations! I'm a little sad, but I'm glad you won!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Sigh… I can't believe the day has come when I lose to Urara.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Hehe. You sound so nonchalant, but your eyes look awful red.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: I'm not listening! I'm nooot listening!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Everyone… Heehee, thanks for the congratulations!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: I'm so glad I got to race you all. Usually I only ever see your backs!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: I must have gotten stronger, huh? Heehee…

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: It sure feels good to get first place! This is even better than I dreamed!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Haru Urara has finally raced on the stage of her dreams!
